Thank you for your interest in Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo!

Students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer. Cal Poly San Luis Obispo campus has specific selection criteria for transfer students for admissions, and we encourage you to check the selection criteria for the major you are interested in. 

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements for this major
  • Admissions website for current transfer admission requirements for San Luis Obispo campus
  • Cal Poly website for information on our campus
